text: {"score":3,"justification":"Core numbers match the card: 24.1% vs 3.4% expected, risk score 5.91, z 2.95, 37% low-complexity, 17 documented, 5 documented 99215s, 0 below billed, 3 of 15 with no lab. The leaning and caution are reasonable, but several narrative claims are wrong or unsupported, and the next steps do not match the rationale, so an investigator would need to redo some checks.","problems":["Claims 99215 shares run above the all-provider rate in 'every complexity band'; the 3-condition band (0.154 vs 0.088) and others are fine, but the narrative treats this as uniform when 0-condition 14.8% vs 2.1% etc. is okay. However the 3-condition band is only 2 of 13 visits, so the thin counts are not flagged.","Says 'rash on C0092070 and C0092122', but the card shows only dx R21 and no description; R21 is rash, so this is an inference not shown on the card. Also cited as upper respiratory infection J06.9 for C0091987 and C0091972, which is correct.","Rationale says 'higher MDM on four sampled 99215 claims' and 'five documented 99215 claims all support billed level', but one example (C0092135) has no minutes recorded, and the supported-by-time evidence is not noted.","Comparison figure '15% for comparison providers' is correct (0.147), but the summary does not note that 5 documented claims is too few to compare to that rate.","The narrative recommends pulling charts for the low-complexity 99215 claims listed, but the actual next_steps ask for a larger sample of 99214 and 99215 claims and a re-screen; they do not name the specific claims or the repeat patients, so they are vague and inconsistent with the rationale.","Cites only two claims (C0091944, C0091952) in the examples. The first is a diabetes visit, which is a weak example of low-complexity, and the repeat-patient claims (M0038800, M0038752) and the J06.9 claims named in the text are not in the cited list.","The 'cloned or inflated documentation' suggestion rests on only 3 notes, which is speculative; the summary calls it weak evidence, so the language is mostly cautious.","The numeric checker flagged '99215', which is only the CPT code and not a real mismatch."]}
